slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Does Passover blood point to Jesus? Israelite families marked their doors with blood and escaped a deadly plague. Paul says Jesus’s blood saves people from God’s judgement.
slides.body: Israelite families marked their doors with blood and escaped a deadly plague. Paul says Jesus’s blood saves people from God’s judgement.
slides.heading: Does Passover blood point to Jesus?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Exod 12:13: The blood on the houses where you are staying will be a sign; when I see the blood, I will pass over you.
slides.body: The blood on the houses where you are staying will be a sign; when I see the blood, I will pass over you.
slides.heading: Exod 12:13

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Rom 5:8–9, BSB: Since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!
slides.body: Since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from wrath through Him!
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Rom 5:8–9

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them Both stories involve blood and rescue from death or judgement. Christians see Passover as an early picture of salvation through Jesus’s sacrifice.
slides.body: Both stories involve blood and rescue from death or judgement. Christians see Passover as an early picture of salvation through Jesus’s sacrifice.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But the rescues are different In Exodus, the blood protects households during a plague. The passage says nothing about forgiveness of sins. Paul does not mention Passover in the verses used for this claim.
slides.body: In Exodus, the blood protects households during a plague. The passage says nothing about forgiveness of sins. Paul does not mention Passover in the verses used for this claim.
